entries.label: Morning brief
entries.text:
Today's session — 72 minutes of easy jogging:

Today's 72-minute easy jog is your planned session, and it's a perfect opportunity to focus on your breathing and find a steady pace. This run is all about consistency and letting your body do what it does best. Show up, lace up, and enjoy the movement — you'll feel great afterward.
